name: Ruined stone arch
description: A broken free-standing arch of weathered grey-brown sandstone blocks: a full-height left pier with a ragged wall stump, the round arch reaching just past its crown before it breaks off, the right pier broken below the springing; fallen blocks and a voussoir in the grass, ivy climbing the left pier and spilling over the arch.

provenance.prompt: ruin_arch_stone: a broken free-standing stone arch with fallen blocks and ivy, about 3 × 1 × 3.5 m (plan 3, item 16).
